secrets.name: The Seed Cellar
secrets.text: Under the desk, down the ladder: a cellar of sacks and jars and seed catalogues, every one a different wheat. Someone has been planting the field from the books, a row at a time, for a very long while.

meta.label: The Wheat Field
meta.blurb: Between the bookcases, where the floor should be, there is a field of wheat, ripe and gold and shoulder high. It moves as if in a wind. There is no wind.
